jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Peptide Scientist - External API Development (all genders) (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Peptide Scientist - External API Development (all genders)

As a Senior Principal Peptide Scientist External API Development (m/f/d), you shape the chemical foundation of our peptide pipeline by defining and delivering phase-appropriate drug substance strategies, synthetic routes, manufacturing processes, and supply solutions through an external CDMO network. In this role, you represent Drug Substance Chemistry within the global CMC Technical Development team and are accountable for the drug substance contribution to the overall CMC package. Apply if you want to combine scientific leadership with strategic decision-making and pragmatic execution across development and manufacturing.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You lead the design, evaluation, and optimization of synthetic routes and manufacturing processes for peptide APIs, balancing speed, quality, safety, cost, sustainability, scalability, and process understanding
- You define phase-appropriate drug substance strategies and select suitable peptide synthesis, purification, isolation, and manufacturing approaches
- You Provide scientific expertise on protecting-group strategies, coupling and deprotection, aggregation, epimerization, oxidation, impurity formation, purification, isolation, and stability
- Translating discovery-scale and SAR-driven chemistry into reproducible, scalable, phase-appropriate processes that enable the transition from Discovery into Development is your responsibility
- You represent Drug Substance Chemistry in cross-functional CMC project teams and contribute to CMC strategy, risk assessment, development planning, supply planning, and regulatory documentation
- You steer, challenge, and approve route design, process development, scale-up, and manufacturing proposals from external partners
- Overseeing external development and manufacturing campaigns for toxicology studies, clinical trials, registration, launch, and commercial supply, including timelines, risks, budgets, supply scenarios, and partner deliverables is part of your function
- Lead process transfers across external partners and into internal development or manufacturing organizations, ensuring knowledge continuity, documentation, troubleshooting, and compliance falls under your responsibility

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a PhD in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, peptide chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, or a closely related scientific discipline
- You bring strong expertise in peptide drug substance development and manufacturing, including solid-phase, liquid-phase, hybrid, fragment-based, and emerging synthesis technologies
- Your hands-on experience in API process development, scale-up, manufacturing, and scientific troubleshooting within an external CDMO model sets you apart
- You demonstrate a solid understanding of phase-appropriate CMC requirements, including strategy development, risk assessment, development and supply planning, and CMC documentation
- Building process understanding and contributing to control strategy concepts for impurities, purification, isolation, and stability is what you are confident in
- You communicate clearly and manage stakeholders effectively in global, cross-functional project environments while making pragmatic decisions
- You apply a strong quality, regulatory, safety, sustainability, and data integrity mindset in development and manufacturing activities
- Fluent English (written and spoken) rounds off your profile

Location disclaimer: This role may be based at one of several locations, including Wuppertal (preferred), Berlin, or Basel.

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure yourb with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.

Key Account Manager, Germany, Austria & Switzerland (GAS)

Location: South Germany (Remote)
Reporting to: Sales Director, Western Europe

Drive the Future of Mobility

At Gilbarco Veeder-Root, we're helping shape the future of fuel retailing, mobility, and payment technologies. For more than 150 years, our solutions have kept the world moving, and today we're at the forefront of innovation as smart cities, vehicle electrification, digital payments, and connected technologies transform the industry.

As a global technology leader, we provide one of the industry's broadest portfolios of integrated solutions, trusted by customers around the world. Now, we're looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager to lead growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

If you're passionate about building strategic customer relationships, developing new business opportunities, and delivering complex technology solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

As Key Account Manager for the GAS region, you will play a critical role in driving sales growth and strengthening Gilbarco Veeder-Root's presence across key strategic accounts. Acting as the primary customer contact within the region, you'll develop long-term partnerships, identify new opportunities, and lead the execution of our go-to-market strategy.

Working closely with colleagues across sales, business development, marketing, and operations, you'll help shape growth plans, influence customer strategies, and bring innovative solutions to market.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build, develop, and maintain trusted relationships with key customers across the GAS region
- Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring exceptional customer engagement and support
- Develop and execute account growth plans to achieve ambitious sales objectives
- Identify and convert new business opportunities within existing and prospective customer accounts
- Create and manage a strong sales pipeline while driving sustainable revenue growth
- Lead customer negotiations and prepare compelling commercial proposals, quotations, and tenders
- Promote Gilbarco Veeder-Root's portfolio of products, services, and technology solutions
- Support the implementation of regional go-to-market and business growth strategies
- Collaborate with sales, business development, marketing, and channel teams to maximise opportunities
- Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings
- Drive market awareness initiatives and support the launch of new solutions and services

WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications)

What You'll Bring

Essential Experience & Skills

- Proven success in Key Account Management and B2B sales environments
- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing complex customer relationships
- Experience developing strategic account plans and delivering measurable business growth
- Understanding of solution-based selling, project sales, and partner-led business models
- Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills
- Strong presentation and stakeholder management capabilities
- Experience working with CRM systems and sales analytics tools
- Project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives effectively
- Fluent German and English language skills

Advantageous Experience

- Knowledge of fuel retail, forecourt technologies, or mobility markets
- Understanding of digital payments, retail technology, or connected services
- Experience working within an international manufacturing or technology business
- Success working in cross-functional and culturally diverse environments
- Experience managing customers across multiple European markets

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline
- Additional qualifications in project management, business development, marketing, or sales are beneficial

WHO IS GILBARCO VEEDER-ROOT

Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems.

WHO IS VONTIER

WHO IS VONTIER
Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.

With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com (https://www.vontier.com/)

At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.

Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.

Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.

Together, let’s power the way the world moves!

jobs.occupation: Direct Procurement Manager (m/f/d) (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description:
You want to do more than manage purchase orders — you want to own category strategy, lead supplier negotiations, and directly impact the P&L? Then take ownership of direct materials sourcing for an international niche world leader.

Salary: €90,000 – 120,000 / year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Bexbach

Why join us?

- Strategic ownership: you own your categories globally, not just execute someone else's sourcing plan
- Direct influence on P&L through savings, cost modeling, and supplier negotiations
- Hands-on role combined with strategic scope — close to sites, not just headquarters theory
- Hybrid working possible where travel and supplier meetings allow [please confirm extent]
- 28 days of vacation, plus Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve automatically off

About us – in brief

Headquartered in Bexbach, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5% – built on a sole focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research and technology development.

Aufgaben

- Lead sourcing, negotiation, and contracting for direct materials (raw materials, packaging, components) to achieve savings, quality, and supply continuity
- Own assigned categories globally: develop sourcing strategies, benchmark markets, and drive competitive positioning
- Lead supplier business reviews and category meetings, ensuring alignment across Procurement, Technical, and Operations
- Identify and qualify new suppliers to enhance competitiveness and reduce supply risk
- Lead complex supplier negotiations leveraging cost breakdowns, volume leverage, and market trends
- Develop and execute negotiation playbooks with the Strategic Sourcing Specialist
- Manage long-term agreements, payment terms, and escalation clauses in line with group governance
- Build and maintain cost models, track raw material indices, and perform variance analysis
- Analyze supplier quotations, freight trends, and payment terms to determine total cost of ownership (TCO)
- Maintain and improve supplier relationships through structured performance reviews and scorecards
- Partner with QA/Technical teams to resolve non-conformances and ensure preventive actions
- Lead cross-functional alignment on material specifications, MOQ rationalization, and cost-saving projects
- Act as mentor and point of escalation for sourcing or supplier-related issues within the Procurement team

Qualifikation

Must-have

- Bachelor's degree and 5–10 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a manufacturing or regulated environment (pharma, nutraceutical, or chemical industry preferred)
- Proven expertise in negotiation and contract management for raw materials, packaging, and services
- Demonstrated experience in vendor qualification programs and supplier audits
- Strong analytical and financial skills (cost modeling, spend analysis, TCO evaluation)
- Strong understanding of cGMP and quality management requirements
- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, NAV, Business Central) and advanced Excel/Power BI skills
- Effective written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice-to-have

- Certifications such as CSCP, MCIPS, or equivalent
- Formal training in negotiation or strategic sourcing
- Excellent project management, planning, and organizational skills
- High level of initiative, autonomy, and accountability in delivering business results

Benefits

Your benefits

- A varied role in an innovative company with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths
- Hybrid working possible where travel and supplier meetings allow
- 28 days of vacation, plus Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve automatically off
- Individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company
- Competitive compensation with Christmas and vacation bonuses
- Company pension scheme
- Free water and coffee
- Company products at employee prices
- Regular team events

What happens next

Bexbach |  Immediate start | ⏳ Full-time

Send us your application, no need for a perfectly polished cover letter. We'll get back to you promptly.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team,
Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or per mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Please submit your application documents in English.
